_readme: Refinancing radar: LIKELY LOAN SIZE rules (used by scripts/radar_size.py).
Companies House never shows loan amounts, so size is INFERRED from public signals.
No figures from filed accounts are used; only the accounts filing TYPE (group/full/small/micro).
Every threshold below is an ASSUMPTION for Marcus to tune. Keys starting with '_' are comments.
Strengths: strong / medium_strong / medium / weak / negative. 'medium_strong' counts as a medium for the
'two mediums' rule but carries more points. Points per strength are in 'points'.

points._assumption: Points per signal strength. A single strong signal alone reaches the £10m+ threshold.

bands._assumption: A band needs BOTH its minimum score AND (>= 1 strong OR >= 2 medium) signals counted for that band.

possible.label: Possible
possible._note: any positive signal that does not reach a Likely band

unlikely.label: Unlikely
unlikely._note: micro-entity accounts (unless a strong signal), or no positive signals; excluded from the email and counted

_micro_entity_note: ASSUMPTION: micro-entity accounts cap the verdict at Possible even with a strong signal (a micro-entity's balance sheet is normally far below a £5m loan).

capacity._assumption: Capacity thresholds by asset type. '10m' meets the £10m+ band, '5m' the £5m-10m band. All ASSUMPTIONS.

sen_places._note: ASSUMPTION: SEN school pupil places (GIAS capacity)

capacity_weight._assumption: How much a capacity figure counts, by how sure we are it is the charged asset.
_definitions: confirmed: regulator file (CQC/GIAS), VOA/EPC, or a web figure for a charge that names the property address
likely: from a 'likely' ownership/news identification, or a web figure where the charge gives no address
provider_total: CQC/GIAS totals across an operator's whole estate (not necessarily all charged)

rateable_value._assumption: VOA 2026 rateable value (only when the asset profile matched the property).

portfolio._assumption: Portfolio signal (medium). Charges: one facility often registers 2-3 charges on the same day (legal charge, debenture, rent assignment), so charges must also span >= 2 creation dates.

accounts._assumption: Latest accounts filing TYPE from the Companies House profile (never the figures).
accounts._none: small, total-exemption, unaudited-abridged, audit-exemption-subsidiary and others score nothing

parent._assumption: Parent / PSC names suggesting a listed company, REIT, institutional fund or sovereign-backed group (medium).

syndication._assumption: Lender named as agent/trustee for other lenders, or several corporate lenders on one charge = syndicated/club debt (strong).
syndication._neutral_agent_note: ASSUMPTION: when the agent/trustee is a clearing bank, UK challenger or specialist lender (e.g. 'Barclays Security Trustee Limited', 'NatWest as security trustee'), it is usually a bilateral loan with hedging, so it counts as medium, not strong. Keeps 'clearing bank alone never Likely'.

lender_categories._assumption: Section names in scripts/radar_lenders_10m_plus.txt. Large-ticket specialists score; clearing banks / UK challengers / small-ticket specialists score NOTHING (they lend at every size).
